quick_facts.sprint_goal: Build the product catalog — every store can manage SKUs with VNĐ pricing and VAT rates. Cashiers can search products. First frontend screens ship this sprint.

content.tldr: Sprint 2 introduces the product/SKU catalog and kicks off the React frontend. Depends on Sprint 1 (auth + store) being complete.

features_committed.title: Product / SKU Catalog
features_committed.rationale: Products are required before any Order can be created. Unblocks Sprint 3.

also_this_sprint: Frontend scaffold: Vite + React 18 + Zustand + React Query + Tailwind/shadcn setup
Login page + JWT token management (frontend auth flow wired to Sprint 1 backend)
Product listing and create/edit forms (first real UI screens)
prerequisites: auth feature: T001–T010 done (backend running, JWT working)
store feature: T001–T005 done (store endpoints live)

what_went_well: Backend T001-T005 delivered cleanly with 13 passing unit tests
Frontend scaffold, auth flow, product list + form all done in one pass
tsc --noEmit and vite build both clean
Docker + nginx routing completed without issues
what_to_improve: Frontend scaffold should be done at sprint start, not after backend

Add E2E Playwright smoke test for login flow in Sprint 3
